chunks: And through his chain of narration from Abi Basir, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) – or Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) – say: Whoever wishes for his dwelling and abode to be Paradise, let him not neglect the Ziyarah of the oppressed one. I asked, 'Who is he?' He replied: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), the master of Karbala. Whoever visits him with yearning for him, and love for the Messenger of Allah, and love for Fatimah, and love for the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him), Allah will seat him at the tables of Paradise, eating with them while the people are undergoing judgment.
ai.seo_question: Who is the oppressed one whose Ziyarah guarantees Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarah* elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) from a devotional act to a soteriological necessity, linking it directly to the love of the Ahl al-Bayt. It emphasizes that sincere Ziyarah, motivated by love for the Prophet, Fatimah, and Ali, results in immediate proximity to divine grace, symbolized by dining at the tables of Paradise while others are still undergoing judgment.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain narrated to me through his Isnād from Abī Basīr, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) – or Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) – say: Those who want their destination and abode to be Paradise should not neglect going to the Ziyārah of the oppressed one. I asked, “Who is the oppressed one?” Imam (a.s.) replied: Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.), the man of Karbalā. Allāh will make those who go to his Ziyārah yearning for him and with love for the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.), love for Fāťimah (s.a.), and love for the Commander of the Believers (a.s.), sit at the Mawā`id of Paradise. They will be eating with them while others are undergoing the process of Judgment.
